summary: IRGC shot down a US MQ-9 Reaper over the Strait of Hormuz, marking a significant escalation in US-Iran tensions. Israel declared it will not withdraw from its current Gaza positions while its defense minister replaced the Central Command chief amid political controversy. In southern Lebanon, a Lebanese army vehicle hit a Hezbollah IED wounding five soldiers, and drones violated Beirut's airspace.

sections.executive_summary: IRGC shot down a US MQ-9 Reaper over the Strait of Hormuz, marking a significant escalation in US-Iran tensions. Israel declared it will not withdraw from its current Gaza positions while its defense minister replaced the Central Command chief amid political controversy. In southern Lebanon, a Lebanese army vehicle hit a Hezbollah IED wounding five soldiers, and drones violated Beirut's airspace.

points: IRGC aerospace forces shot down a US MQ-9 Reaper drone over the Strait of Hormuz using a modern and advanced air defense system, per IRGC announcement. (Source: @presstv/201421)
Iran and Oman are in the final stages of negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz; the new pathway does not signify official opening or closure of the strait. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6035)

Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei stated no Iran-US talks are ongoing; current negotiations are bilateral between Iran and Oman, while Trump announced talks would start Monday 12 Mordad. (Source: @VahidOnline/77716)

Al-Mayadeen cited an Iranian source saying the US offered a concession on closing the southern route in the Strait of Hormuz; Iran rejected opening the strait until the war ends completely. (Source: @yediotnews25/133537)

A Telegram channel claimed Trump threatened to strike an Iranian power plant for each ship targeted in Hormuz, and that 10 ships have been destroyed by the IRGC since that threat. (Source: @kianmeli1/90558)
Baghaei said US attacks on residential and civilian areas in Qeshm, Minab, and Lamerd constitute war crimes; Tehran will pursue international accountability. (Source: @presstv/201419)

Defense Minister Israel Katz publicly denounced IDF Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth and announced his replacement on live television; Bluth has served over two years since July 2024. (Source: @manniefabian/58916)
Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir informed the General Staff forum and Brigadier General candidates that no major general appointments will be made until 2027 due to elections. (Source: @yediotnews25/133528)
A political source stated Israel will not withdraw from its current line in the Gaza Strip and will continue to thwart all threats to civilians and soldiers. (Source: @amitsegal/63600)
Ministers Strook and Smotrich demanded a revote in the cabinet on the Gaza deal, claiming they were given misinformation. (Source: @N12chat/220438)

IDF spokesperson confirmed a Lebanese army vehicle hit an IED near Kafra in southern Lebanon, lightly wounding five soldiers; the device was not Israeli and likely belonged to Hezbollah. (Source: @New_security8200/203154)

Defense Minister's office said Chief of Staff recommended Maj. Gen. Dado Bar Kalifa for Central Command in April; Katz interviewed him in June and decided to appoint him in the next round. (Source: @inon_yttach/9793)
US CENTCOM intelligence analysts were asked by a senior officer to generate creative unconventional ways to pressure and punish Iran, intended for President Trump. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6033)
A political source affirmed Israel will not withdraw from its current positions in the Gaza Strip and will continue to thwart threats to civilians and soldiers. (Source: @amitsegal/63600)
Ministers Strook and Smotrich demanded a cabinet revote on the Gaza agreement, alleging they received incorrect information. (Source: @N12chat/220438)
No specific operational updates on Gaza or West Bank military activity were reported in the source messages.
Enemy drones continue to violate the airspace over Beirut's southern suburbs. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382683)
Lebanese army initially claimed five soldiers were lightly wounded in an Israeli strike in Bint Jbeil, southern Lebanon. (Source: @inon_yttach/9787)
Lebanese army walked back the claim; examination determined the explosion was caused by a suspicious object, likely Hezbollah. (Source: @manniefabian/58914)

IDF confirmed a Lebanese army vehicle struck an IED in the Kafra area, outside the security zone, wounding five soldiers; no IDF forces were present; the device likely belonged to Hezbollah. (Source: @New_security8200/203154)
Red Alert Lebanon operates a volunteer alert network via WhatsApp and bots for reporting hostile drone or aircraft activity. (Source: @redlinkleb/34536)
Iraq's Popular Mobilization Forces raised a 2,500 square meter banner between the two holy shrines carrying images of martyrs. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86811)
No specific conflict-related developments in Syria or Iraq were reported in the source messages.
Iran and Oman are in final stages of negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz, per Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6035)
UKMTO reported an explosion 20 nautical miles northeast of Khasab, Oman; the tanker master reported an explosion close to the vessel, but vessel and crew are safe. (Source: @shin_persian/8791)
An explosion at a car exhibition on Sheikh Zayed Road in the UAE killed one person and injured five others. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382697)

US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth stated US forces remain at the highest readiness level since World War II; Trump's delay of a strike on Iran did not affect military preparedness. (Source: @VahidOnline/77715)

Israeli political source states Israel will not withdraw from its current positions in the Gaza Strip and will continue to thwart all threats to civilians and soldiers. (Source: @amitsegal/63600)

A Lebanese army vehicle struck an improvised explosive device near Kafra in southern Lebanon, lightly wounding five soldiers; the IDF assessed the device belonged to Hezbollah, not Israeli forces. (Source: @New_security8200/203154)

US Central Command intelligence analysts were tasked by a senior officer to generate creative unconventional options to pressure and punish Iran, intended for President Trump's consideration. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6033)

Iran rejected a US concession regarding the southern route of the Strait of Hormuz, refusing to open the waterway until the war ends completely, according to an Iranian source cited by Al-Mayadeen. (Source: @yediotnews25/133537)

Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz publicly announced the replacement of Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth after over two years in the role, citing a policy of promoting commanders with proven aggressiveness. (Source: @manniefabian/58916)

The UK Maritime Trade Operations reported an explosion 20 nautical miles northeast of Khasab, Oman; the tanker's master reported the explosion close to the vessel, but the vessel and crew are safe. (Source: @shin_persian/8791)
sections.threat_assessment: The downing of a US MQ-9 Reaper by the IRGC over the Strait of Hormuz represents a direct kinetic escalation between Iran and the United States, raising the risk of broader maritime conflict. Israel's refusal to withdraw from Gaza and its internal command turmoil — replacing the Central Command chief while freezing senior appointments — suggest operational continuity but political instability. Hezbollah's apparent use of IEDs against Lebanese army vehicles in southern Lebanon indicates the group retains freedom of action despite the ceasefire, potentially drawing Israel into further cross-border incidents. The US CENTCOM request for unconventional pressure options on Iran signals Washington is preparing coercive measures short of war, while Iran's rejection of Hormuz concessions until war ends links maritime security to Gaza's fate.
